claims.claim: Ethan Mollick asked Fable 5.2 and Gemini Carbon to solve the Fermi Paradox by marshaling data, testing hypotheses, and pressure-testing them against critics.
claims.episode_span: A researcher named Ethan Mollick gave two different AI models the same big challenge: solve the Fermi Paradox.
claims.source_title: AI models tackle Fermi Paradox with mixed results
claims.supporting_quote: I asked Fable 5.2 & Gemini Carbon to "Solve the Fermi Paradox. Marshal data, test hypotheses, pressure test them against critics, give me likely answers if you cant get a definite conclusion"

claims.claim: The models did not solve the Fermi Paradox but produced interesting results including data gathering and hypothesis testing.
claims.episode_span: The models did not solve the paradox completely.
claims.source_title: AI models tackle Fermi Paradox with mixed results
claims.supporting_quote: They did not solve it, but did do interesting stuff.

claims.claim: Claude Fable 5.2 turned a vague paragraph into the playable game Dread & District after multiple agents argued about art, lore, and jokes.
claims.episode_span: Claude Fable 5.2 took one short paragraph describing a transport simulation game with heart and turned it into a complete playable experience.
claims.source_title: Claude Fable creates fantasy transport sim game
claims.supporting_quote: I gave Claude Fable 5.2 a vague paragraph asking for a fantasy transport sim with heart. Then I left it to a bunch of agents arguing about art, lore and jokes. Now here is Dread & District, where good logistics defeats evil.
